observations: body L1, L18: the heads of the notes on chapters 9 and 10, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals, in the larger type of the heads.
body L2: the dash of «21-22» measures 4.0 pt, shorter than the long dash of «l. 1–6» on p. 178 (5.4 pt); transcribed as a hyphen.
body L4: «t. I» is printed with a broken t; the dash of «70–71» measures 4.6 pt and is transcribed as a long dash.

body L7, L9, L11, L13-L14, L17, L20: the minus signs of «180°— 2φ», «180°— 2P», «90°— P», «P — 90°», «— cos P» and «90°— h» are printed as long dashes, that of «180° − 2ε» as a short one; all are set as minus signs.
body L11: a speck stands over the equals sign; it is not a sign.

body L5-L17: the formulas are checked. In the figure of p. 177, with ZB = φ, BA = 90° − φ, ZH = 90° − ε, HT = ε, TE = 90° − P and EA = 90°, Menelaus' theorem (Almagest II, 3) gives L7, L9 and L11 as printed (chorda 2a = 2 sin a, chorda 180° = 2R). Ptolemy's P is the least semidiurnal arc, al-Battānī's the greatest; with sin (P − 90°) = − cos P rule (α) is the modern cos P = − tg φ tg ε, and (β) with the declination δ is − cos P = tg φ tg δ, as in note 1.

body L21-L30: the figure stands at the left of lines 21 to 30, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the gnomon AB, its shadow CB and the ray AC as solid lines (the angle at C measures 34.5°); the line DGA, the sine GF, the ray produced CF, the line BE and the quadrant DFE about A in dashes, each dash where it printed; the angle h marked at A and at C; the braces of cos h, sin h and p; the letters and the words in the italic of the text.
body L21-L30: the label under the shadow is printed «umbra cxtensa», with c for the e of extensa; kept as printed.
body L23: the dash of «13–15» touches its figures; transcribed as a long dash, as in the ranges of the other lines.
body L24: the formula (α) is checked: by the similar triangles ABC and AGF (L29-L30), CB : p = cos h : sin h.
body L26: a speck stands before «xaginta» at the left of the line; it is not a sign.
notes L1: the minus sign before «cos P» is printed short and apart from it, and the equals sign is blotted.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
